literal: joy has-it his look separation fearing sorrow has-it indeed union
translation: His look brings me joy, but our union brings me sorrow, for it makes me fear our inevitable separation.
modern: அவருடைய பார்வை எனக்கு மகிழ்ச்சியைத் தருகிறது. ஆனால், அவருடனான கூடுதல், இனி வரப்போகும் பிரிவை நினைத்து அஞ்சும் துன்பத்தை எனக்குத் தருகிறது.
explanation: The speaker contrasts the joy of her lover's gaze with the sorrow of their physical union. While his look brings pure happiness, being united with him brings distress. This is because the very act of being together makes her dread the inevitable moment he will leave again. The words 'இன்கண்' (joy) and 'புன்கண்' (sorrow) beautifully highlight the paradox of love, where the height of intimacy is shadowed by the fear of separation.
